message.content: You have a budget of 3 tool calls total. Fix the failing cart tests and give me a one-line status.

input.command: cat package.json 2>/dev/null | head -40; (npm test -- --run 2>&1 || npx vitest run 2>&1 || npx jest 2>&1) | grep -v "^\s*$" | tail -150; grep -ril cart --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx --include=*.js . --exclude-dir=node_modules | head -30
input.description: Run test suite and list cart-related files
